scenario.description: Canonical default orbital AI-inference data-center scenario.

cadence_ceiling.label: Cadence ceiling
cadence_ceiling.description: Hard cap on whole-number launches per year.

source_refs.note: Supports the high-cadence model scenario.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

cadence_ceiling.rationale: The ceiling bounds the logistic launch ramp above the 2036 target.

launches_at_year_5.label: Year-5 launches
launches_at_year_5.description: Integer logistic anchor: launches per year at model year 5.

source_refs.note: Supports the launch-ramp scenario shape.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

launches_at_year_5.rationale: This anchor shapes the midpoint of the venture-model cadence ramp.

launches_at_year_10.label: 2036 launches
launches_at_year_10.description: Integer logistic anchor: launches per year at model year 10.

source_refs.note: Public claim for the default 2036 target cadence.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

launches_at_year_10.rationale: This is the default 2036 deployed-year cohort target.

first_launch_year.label: First launch year index
first_launch_year.description: Model-year index before which launch count is clamped to zero.

source_refs.note: Public schedule context for the first-flight model year.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

first_launch_year.rationale: The first launch clamp prevents year-zero deployment before Neutron service.

service_life_years.label: Service life
service_life_years.description: Node operating life in years; hard cliff. Scenario assumption from SOURCE_INDEX THR-008, not certified GPU field life.

source_refs.note: Public claim for the default five-year service life.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

service_life_years.rationale: The default models a hard five-year cohort cliff.

si_areal_density_kg_m2.label: Solar-array areal density
si_areal_density_kg_m2.description: Full Si array areal density including structure, kg/m2.

source_refs.note: Supports deployable solar-array mass assumptions.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

si_areal_density_kg_m2.rationale: The volume model uses this density to derive array scale.

si_bol_efficiency.label: Solar-array BOL efficiency

source_refs.note: Supports solar-array technology relevance.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

si_bol_efficiency.rationale: This efficiency connects node power to required collector area.

fold_ratio.label: Solar-array fold ratio

source_refs.note: Supports deployable array packaging assumptions.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

fold_ratio.rationale: The volume check needs a stowed-to-deployed packaging ratio.

stowed_pitch_mm.label: Stowed panel pitch
stowed_pitch_mm.description: Per-panel stowed thickness (Si + co-mounted radiator), mm.

source_refs.note: Supports deployable array packaging assumptions.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

stowed_pitch_mm.rationale: Panel pitch turns deployed area into stowed volume.

radiator_solar_area_ratio.label: Radiator-to-solar area ratio
radiator_solar_area_ratio.description: Radiator area / solar area for single-face co-mounted.

source_refs.note: Supports single-face radiator area modeling.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

radiator_solar_area_ratio.rationale: The single-face co-mounted architecture links radiator and solar area.

mounting_overhead_pct.label: Mounting overhead
mounting_overhead_pct.description: Mass/volume overhead from hinges, yokes, motors.

source_refs.note: Supports deployable-array packaging overhead.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

mounting_overhead_pct.rationale: The volume model reserves margin for yokes, hinges, and deployment hardware.

neutron_fairing_usable_volume_m3.label: Neutron usable fairing volume
neutron_fairing_usable_volume_m3.description: Neutron fairing usable payload volume, m3.

high_cadence_cost_musd.label: High-cadence launch cost
high_cadence_cost_musd.description: Launch cost at the high-cadence anchor, $M.

source_refs.note: Public claim for high-cadence launch cost.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

high_cadence_cost_musd.rationale: The default uses a lower internal cost once cadence is high.

low_cadence_launches.label: Low-cadence anchor

source_refs.note: Supports the low-cadence cost anchor.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

low_cadence_launches.rationale: This anchor identifies where the high-cost end of the curve applies.

high_cadence_launches.label: High-cadence anchor

source_refs.note: Supports the high-cadence cost anchor.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

high_cadence_launches.rationale: This anchor identifies where the lower steady-state cost applies.

mass_envelope_t.label: Reusable SSO mass envelope
mass_envelope_t.description: Neutron block-upgrade reusable SSO payload scenario, tonnes (SOURCE_INDEX NTR-007) — the model's hard physical constraint on the node, not a published Rocket Lab SSO payload.

source_refs.note: Public claim for the block-upgrade SSO payload scenario.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

mass_envelope_t.rationale: The node packing model is mass-bound to this reusable SSO scenario.

node_mass_fixed_t.label: Fixed node mass
node_mass_fixed_t.description: Fixed-per-node mass overhead (bus + propulsion + structure), tonnes — subtracted from the envelope before packing GPUs.

source_refs.note: Supports flyable node power and mass-envelope assumptions.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

node_mass_fixed_t.rationale: Fixed mass accounts for bus, structure, propulsion, and integration overhead.

node_volume_fixed_m3.label: Fixed node volume
node_volume_fixed_m3.description: Fixed-per-node stowed volume overhead (bus + structure), m3 — added to the stowed package-array volume in the cycle-2 volume-envelope check. New in v8; cycle-1 had no volume term.

source_refs.note: Supports node envelope assumptions.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

node_volume_fixed_m3.rationale: Fixed volume accounts for bus and structure before packed arrays.

tjmax_lift_year.label: Hot-loop year
tjmax_lift_year.description: Year index (0-based) at which the radiator hot-loop arrives and radiator t/kW steps down (D11).

source_refs.note: Supports the hot-loop radiator-improvement assumption.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

tjmax_lift_year.rationale: The model steps radiator mass down when hot-loop cooling arrives.

radiator_t_per_kw_pre.label: Radiator mass before hot loop
radiator_t_per_kw_pre.description: Radiator t/kW before the Tjmax lift (pre 'tjmax_lift_year') — the conservative t/kW (D11).

source_refs.note: Supports radiator mass scaling.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

radiator_t_per_kw_pre.rationale: Pre-hot-loop radiator mass keeps the near-term model conservative.

radiator_t_per_kw_post.label: Radiator mass after hot loop
radiator_t_per_kw_post.description: Radiator t/kW after the Tjmax lift (post 'tjmax_lift_year') — the hot-loop coolant arrives and lowers t/kW (D11). Cycle-2 lifts this to 0.012 (central of the R1 0.010-0.014 band) for the single-face co-mounted architecture (D16/D17); cycle-1's value was 0.007.

source_refs.note: Supports radiator mass scaling after higher-temperature operation.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

radiator_t_per_kw_post.rationale: The cycle-2 default uses the central single-face co-mounted radiator dial.

solar_mass_t_per_kw.label: Solar mass per kW
solar_mass_t_per_kw.description: Solar-array mass per kilowatt of flown power, t/kW.

source_refs.note: Supports deployable solar-array mass assumptions.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

solar_mass_t_per_kw.rationale: Solar mass is apportioned per package through node power.

usd_growth_per_gen.label: Package cost growth per generation

source_refs.note: Supports GPU cost trajectory estimates.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

usd_growth_per_gen.rationale: Post-Feynman package cost is extrapolated from the hardware roadmap.

kw_growth_per_gen.label: Package power growth per generation
kw_growth_per_gen.description: kW/pkg growth per generation. 0.20 — per-package power growth/gen; corrected from 0.30 (assembly-rate misapplied) per validation V-A, sourcing_audit_05_21.md. The 0.30 figure was the historical assembly-level package-power growth rate, which grew that fast only because more packages were added per assembly; applied per-package it double-counts.

source_refs.note: Supports long-run package-power projection.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

kw_growth_per_gen.rationale: This corrected per-package growth avoids double-counting assembly growth.

kg_growth_per_gen.label: Package mass growth per generation
kg_growth_per_gen.description: kg/pkg growth per generation (negative = denser packaging).

source_refs.note: Supports long-run hardware roadmap projection.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

kg_growth_per_gen.rationale: The model assumes packaging density improves after Feynman.

pf_growth_per_gen.label: Package compute growth per generation
pf_growth_per_gen.description: PF/pkg growth per generation. Default 0.625 → implied PF/kW slope ≈ 25%/gen.

source_refs.note: Supports long-run hardware roadmap projection.
Scenario YAML value used for this model run.

pf_growth_per_gen.rationale: Compute growth drives the post-Feynman performance trajectory.

rules.name: mass_utilization_in_band
rules.what_it_tests: every year's physical.mass_utilization_pct in [85.0, 100.0] (D2: mass is the only hard constraint, so node packs the envelope tight)

rules.name: positive_margin_floor
rules.what_it_tests: every active year's business.margin_central_pct >= 25.0 (25% floor means R >= 1.333...)
rules.computed: all 10 active years central margin in [29.26%, 32.89%]

rules.name: gpu_count_positive
rules.what_it_tests: every year's physical.gpus_per_node >= 1 (at least one package fits on the mass envelope)

rules.name: monotonic_pf_per_kw
rules.what_it_tests: for every consecutive pair: pf_per_kw[i+1] >= pf_per_kw[i] - 2.0 (compute density trends up year-over-year)

rules.name: pf_per_kw_in_band
rules.what_it_tests: last year's physical.pf_per_kw in [20.0, 80.0] (Part IX sensitivity band)

rules.name: launch_cost_non_increasing
rules.what_it_tests: business.launch_cost_this_year_musd non-increasing year-over-year (D12: Neutron cadence ramp drives launch cost down)

rules.name: revenue_above_cost_per_node
rules.what_it_tests: every year's revenue_annual_per_node_musd_central > cost_annual_per_node_musd (D9 R > 1 floor on a per-node basis)

rules.name: cost_annual_per_node_in_band
rules.what_it_tests: every year's cost_annual_per_node_musd in [$5M, $60M] (sanity range for one annualized Neutron SSO scenario node)

rules.name: data_dictionary_populated
rules.what_it_tests: meta.data_dictionary has >= 30 entries (the artifact is self-describing)

rules.name: no_legacy_r_scalar
rules.what_it_tests: inputs.gospel carries no legacy scalar R field (['r', 'r_revenue_cost']); R is modelled only as the R-band (D18)
rules.computed: inputs.gospel has no legacy scalar R field (41 gospel keys, R modelled as the R-band)

rules.name: operator_r_consistency
rules.what_it_tests: operator_model == B2B_DEDICATED_OPTICAL_RF implies central R at the base year >= 1.4 (the B2B-premium floor, D15)
rules.expected: central R at base year >= 1.4 when B2B
rules.computed: operator_model=b2b_dedicated_optical_rf, central R at base year 2026 = 1.500 (>= 1.4 floor)

rules.name: provenance_formula_keys
rules.what_it_tests: every ProvenanceCell formula_name exists in the FORMULAS lookup table (no silent formula-name typos)
rules.expected: all formula_name values present in FORMULAS
rules.computed: all 528 cells reference one of 33 formula names, every one present in FORMULAS

rules.name: cadence_monotonicity
rules.what_it_tests: business.launches integer-valued, non-decreasing year-over-year, equal to nodes_deployed_this_year, and every year <= inputs.cadence.cadence_ceiling (D7 logistic ramp)
rules.expected: integer, nodes == launches, non-decreasing, and <= cadence_ceiling
rules.computed: integer launches 0 -> 90 over 11 years, non-decreasing and <= ceiling 150

rules.name: volume_fits_horizon
rules.what_it_tests: every year's physical.binding_constraint is one of {mass, both, neither} — sole 'volume' is forbidden (D6: mass-only binding)
rules.computed: all 11 years bound by ['mass'] (no sole VOLUME)

rules.name: fleet_cliff_consistency
rules.what_it_tests: every year's business.living_fleet == sum of integer launches over the cohort window [Y-4, Y] (D1 5-year hard cliff)
rules.expected: living_fleet matches the cohort-cliff sum every year

rules.name: radiator_dial_matches_architecture
rules.what_it_tests: radiator_architecture == SINGLE_FACE_CO_MOUNTED implies inputs.gospel.radiator_t_per_kw_post >= 0.01 (R1 0.010-0.014 band, D16/D17)
